en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, from Ali<sup>asws</sup>,
if one were to walk in one shoe and repair the other, he<sup>asws</sup> did not see any problem with that’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, walked with one shoe while repairing the other one, and he did not consider it harmful.’”
